system.description:
Range: Self

You commune with the spirit realm for guidance.

Over the course of an hour, you enter into a trance-like state to commune with a spiritual creature. You ask the blue spirit for information on a particular topic, sharing what you know and what you wish to learn.

When you use this ability, choose either Astral or Umbral Communion.

  • Astral Communion

    • You reach out to a passing spirit.

    • Most spirits are neutral towards you but are willing to converse. An especially powerful or prideful spirit may demand a small favor.

  • Umbral Communion

    • You reach out to a malicious, demonic entity.

    • Demons are dangerous, but their obsession with the mortal world means they tend to have more useful answers.

    • Demons will almost always demand something from you. They may also offer favors to you.

    • If you anger a demon, it may manifest to attack you.
